import { defineTable, col } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "k" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "v" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "domain" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "mx" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const acls = defineTable("acls", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial().primaryKey(),
        address: col.custom("inet"),
        k: col.text().notNull(),
        v: col.text(),
        domain: col.text(),
        mx: col.text()
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
